title: Senior Dotnet SDET Engineer
description: About Position: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior .NET SDET Engineer with 6-12 years of experience in software quality engineering, automation testing, and test framework development. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automation frameworks for web applications, APIs, and enterprise systems. This role requires strong expertise in .NET technologies, Selenium, API automation, BDD frameworks, and cloud-based testing environments. You will work closely with developers, product teams, and DevOps engineers to ensure the delivery of high-quality, reliable, and scalable software solutions. Role: Senior .NET SDET Engineer Location: Hyderabad Experience: 6 to 12 Years Job Type: Full-Time Employment What You'll Do: Design, develop, and maintain robust automation frameworks using .NET technologies and industry-standard testing practices. Configure and manage Selenium Test Environments (STE) for web application automation. Participate in automation environment setup and framework implementation using Integrated Development Environments (IDEs) and automation tools. Design scalable, reusable, and maintainable test automation architectures aligned with project requirements. Identify, evaluate, and prioritize automation candidates to maximize test coverage and efficiency. Develop automated test scripts for UI, functional, regression, integration, and API testing. Implement API automation solutions for validating RESTful services and microservice-based applications. Create, maintain, and execute BDD-based automated test scenarios using Cucumber or similar frameworks. Develop, enhance, debug, and optimize automation test suites to improve execution efficiency and reliability. Create automation test strategies, test plans, test data management approaches, and quality assurance processes. Execute regression testing and ensure minimal impact from application changes and new feature releases. Track, analyze, and manage defects while collaborating with development teams for issue resolution. Troubleshoot automation failures, object identification issues, environment-related defects, and test execution challenges. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and rapid software delivery. Participate in Agile ceremonies, sprint planning, test planning, code reviews, and quality improvement initiatives. Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners to ensure high-quality deliverables and comprehensive test coverage. Expertise You'll Bring: 6 to 12 years of experience in Software Development, Quality Engineering, Automation Testing, or SDET roles. Strong hands-on experience with C#, .NET Framework, and .NET Core. Proven experience building scalable test automation frameworks from the ground up. Extensive experience with Selenium WebDriver and automation framework development. Strong experience in API automation testing and validating RESTful services. Experience with BDD frameworks such as Cucumber, SpecFlow, or similar behavior-driven testing tools. Knowledge of Rest Assured concepts or equivalent API testing frameworks and methodologies. Experience with JavaScript, Angular, and modern web application technologies. Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, test design techniques, and quality engineering practices. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices using tools such as Azure DevOps, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI/CD. Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP). Strong debugging, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and defect management skills. Knowledge of performance, scalability, load testing, and test automation best practices. Hands-on experience with source control systems such as Git. Experience participating in code reviews and following coding standards and quality guidelines. Strong understanding of Agile and Scrum delivery methodologies. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams in fast-paced development environments. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. Benefits: Competitive salary and benefits package Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards Annual health check-ups Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment: Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds. We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles. Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities. title: Automation Quality Engineer
description: Where Ambition Meets Innovation At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. Your skills, talents, and ideas will redefine what's possible. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad. Join us as we create something extraordinary together. Job Overview We are looking for a UI Automation Test Engineer II who is passionate about quality, automation, and delivering exceptional user experiences. In this role, you will design and maintain UI test automation frameworks, drive end-to-end test coverage for web applications, and partner closely with development and product teams to ship reliable, high-quality software. Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain automated UI test suites for web applications and API using frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress. Write clear, reusable, and maintainable test code using JavaScript, TypeScript, or Python. Develop end-to-end, integration, and regression test coverage aligned to acceptance criteria and user stories. Execute automated test runs locally and within CI/CD pipelines; triage and report failures promptly. Collaborate with developers, designers, and product managers to identify testable requirements early in the development lifecycle. Participate in sprint ceremonies, contribute to test planning, and provide quality sign-off for feature releases. Identify, document, and communicate defects with clear reproduction steps; track issues through to resolution. Review pull requests for testability and contribute to test code quality standards. Continuously evaluate and improve test automation coverage, execution speed, and reliability. Contribute to test strategy documentation and quality best practices across the engineering team. Design, build, and maintain scalable automated test frameworks for functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end testing. Develop and execute automated test suites for data pipelines, APIs, and cloud-based applications on AWS. Validate data accuracy, completeness, and integrity across ETL/ELT workflows, data warehouses, and data platforms. Leverage AI and ML tools to enhance test coverage, generate test cases, and improve anomaly detection. Collaborate with Engineering, Data, and Product teams to define quality standards, acceptance criteria, and test strategies. Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and monitor test results across deployment stages. Identify, document, and track defects; drive root cause analysis and work with development teams toward resolution. Contribute to quality documentation, test plans, and best practices across the engineering organization. Participate in code reviews for test code and provide feedback on testability of application designs. What are we looking for? The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with modern UI automation tools, a solid understanding of frontend application behavior, and the discipline to build maintainable, scalable test suites that integrate seamlessly into CI/CD pipelines. Requirements 5+ years of experience in software quality engineering with a focus on UI automation. Hands-on proficiency with one or more UI automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress Strong working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript; Python experience is a plus. Experience writing page object model (POM) or similar structured test architectures. Solid understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, DOM, and browser developer tools. Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps. Ability to analyze test failures, debug issues, and distinguish test flakiness from genuine defects. Experience with API testing to complement UI coverage (Postman or similar). Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively across engineering and non-engineering stakeholders. Preferences Experience testing Angular, single-page applications. Familiarity with accessibility testing tools and standards (WCAG, axe-core, Lighthouse). Exposure to visual regression testing tools such as Percy or Applitools. Experience with cross-browser and mobile testing strategies. Knowledge of BDD frameworks such as Cucumber or SpecFlow. Familiarity with test reporting tools such as Allure, TestRail, or similar. AWS or cloud platform experience is a plus. Core Competencies Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams Strong ownership mindset and attention to detail Experience working in Agile environments Commitment to continuous learning LPL Global Business Services, LLP - PRIVACY POLICY

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software testing with 5+ years of experience, with a focus on automation testing using Selenium and Java. As a Test Lead, you will be responsible for leading testing efforts, ensuring the quality of our software products, and mentoring junior team members. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve. The team delivers high-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance. DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee). The Impact You Will Have In This Role The Development family is responsible for creating, designing, deploying, and supporting applications, programs, and software solutions. May include research, new development, prototyping, modification, reuse, re-engineering, maintenance, or any other activities related to software products used internally or externally on product platforms supported by the firm. The software development process requires in-depth subject matter expertise in existing and emerging development methodologies, tools, and programming languages. Software Developers work closely with business partners and / or external clients in defining requirements and implementing solutions. The Software Development Engineer In Test (SDET) role encompasses automation development and execution, functional, and non-functional testing.
